facts.fact: ANSUTEN, under the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, launched on 7 October 2025 the third edition of its R-CUN digital capacity programme for over 1,500 participants, with 30-day trainings across the country after two earlier editions of 450.
